summary: ALEE AS (org. no. 937 023 758) is a private limited company (AS) based in Hamar, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-01-23. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 27.400 (Produksjon av belysningsutstyr); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Thomas Øverby; auditor: ECHAS REVISJON AS. Also: LEI 254900L9DIIIEVW1GX32.
